The first public release of Layerwake: see how interfaces are built, and make them your own.

## What's included

- **Layerwake site and workspace.** Import a capture, inspect its layer tree and design tokens, rebuild it with live edits, and export CSS variables, a tokens file and clean HTML/CSS. Everything runs in the browser.
- **Chrome extension (MV3).** Captures one component on any page you can inspect, keeping structure and measurements but leaving page text, attributes, links and asset URLs behind.
- **Demo page.** A practice component plus a ready-made capture.
- **Motion Gallery.** 100 copyable React motion components with live previews. Every one respects reduced-motion settings.
- **Design.** A black, white and snow-white palette with a looping wave background.

## Downloads

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `layerwake-site-*.zip` | Static build of the site. Serve the folder from any static host. |
| `layerwake-extension-*.zip` | Built Chrome extension. Unzip it, open `chrome://extensions`, turn on Developer mode, and choose **Load unpacked**. |
| `layerwake-source-*.zip` | Complete source. Node 24 is recommended. Run `npm ci`, then `npm run dev`. |

Live site: https://layerwake.vercel.app
